88707: Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.
88708: Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily.
88709: Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.
88710: A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as Kumiko. Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school.
88915: A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.
88916: Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words.
88917: Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses.
88918: Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality.
88919: She is a third-year student who quit the Kitauji brass band, having played the tenor saxophone since junior high school. Aoi was Kumiko Oumae and Shuuichi Tsukamoto's childhood friend, two years older than them.
88920: Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.
88921: A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.
88922: A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.
88923: Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before Kumiko Oumae's first year at Kitauji.
88925: A second-year student who is a tall, calm, and taciturn youth. He is the assistant leader of the bass section of the band.
89500: The younger sister of Midori. Kohaku is often noted how closely she resembles her older sister. Kohaku is a shy and timid girl.
120724: Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year. She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time. Sound!
125960: Mizore is a second-year student who plays oboe. She is a very quiet and introverted girl, and despite seeming hard to interact with, she has friends like Natsuki Nakagawa, Yuuko Yoshikawa, and - despite past relationship troubles - Nozomi Kasaki.
129090: Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club. She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with Mizore.
129222: She is a woodwind Instructor brought in by Noboru Taki to help with the Kitauji Concert Band on its path to the national competition. Her main instrument is flute, which she majored in, but she is also highly proficient in all other woodwind instruments.
129223: He is the new percussion instructor for the Kitauji Concert Band, hired by Noboru Taki, his then college classmate, to help with the band on their path to the national band competition. He is an alumnus of Kitauji High School and a former student of Tohru Taki.
133462: Kanade Hisaishi is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a euphonium player in Kumiko's second year. Kanade has a courteous personality and great communication skills, and gives off a good impression to everyone who sees her.
137549: Lala Hitomi is a minor character in the Hibike! Euphonium series. In the main series, she is a first-year student at Kitauji High School who plays the Horn in F. She is also the member of Monaka team. (Source - Hibike! Euphonium WIki)
140036: The mother of Kumiko and Mamiko.
